paras: Upgrade your Subaru WRX or WRX STI's front braking performance with Dixcel brake rotors, engineered in Japan and developed through decades of OEM supply and motorsport experience. Dixcel rotors are designed to deliver consistent braking performance, stable pedal feel, and reliable control for daily driving through to more spirited use.

This listing covers the Dixcel brake rotor types shown for the Subaru WRX STI (VA) fitted with factory Brembo 6-piston front calipers, and the Subaru WRX (VB) models equipped with factory Brembo 6-piston calipers including the 2024 WRX Club Spec and 2025 WRX tS Spec B , all using 340x30mm front rotors . This rotor also suits VB WRX owners who have completed an OEM STI Brembo 6-piston caliper swap.
